'''Napo Popotis''', also referred to as '''Popotis of Iziz''' or '''Popo''', was a renowned [[Onderon/Legends|Onderonian]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] from [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] employed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]].

Popotis became famous [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide for his experimental [[Book/Legends|cookbook]] ''[[Delicacies from the Demon Moon]]''. Popotis, dejected by his [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] bland cuisine made from tough game, became inspired to write this innovative [[Book/Legends|cookbook]] containing flavorful fare which could be made from [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun's]] creatures after he witnessed a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] incident. Popotis saw wild [[Drexl]]s descend upon the shuttle's seasonings and spices, which triggered a zeal to innovate like never before.<ref name="Cookbook" />
